svg.title: Height over time: ground truth vs online odometry
svg.desc: Real trajectories of Experiment 01, SE(3)-aligned as in the evaluation: ground truth, FAST-LIVO2 odometry and RTAB-Map LiDAR+RGB-D odometry (runs 1 and 2). RTAB-Map odometry drifts in height; FAST-LIVO2 follows the ground-truth height closely.
svg.text: Where RTAB-Map's online error comes from: height drift
vertical RMSE on 3,487 common timestamps: FAST-LIVO2 0.025 m · RTAB-Map 0.740 m / 1.351 m
